sources.title: Gaia Research Orchestrator Foundation v1
sources.usage: Canonical Research architecture for provider-agnostic evidence orchestration, evidence normalization, duplicate detection, conflict resolution, provenance, confidence, unknowns, evidence quality scoring, and Executive Intelligence handoff.
sources.limitations: Architecture-only source; does not authorize runtime integrations, production mutations, or provider-specific conclusions.

sources.title: Marketing Research GPT Evidence Provider
sources.usage: Interchangeable evidence provider for marketing, customer, industry, and positioning research signals routed through Gaia.
sources.limitations: Evidence provider only. Outputs require Gaia provenance, validation, confidence scoring, and corroboration before Executive Intelligence use.

sources.title: Public Web Research Evidence Provider

sources.title: CRM Approved Handoff Evidence Provider
sources.usage: Future interchangeable evidence provider for CRM-derived evidence only after explicit CRM-owned Research-safe handoff approval.
sources.limitations: Not active. Does not authorize CRM data access, CRM mutation, production reads, or Executive Intelligence use without future approved handoff.

sources.title: Apollo Lead, Contact, and Company Enrichment
sources.usage: Permitted enrichment source for franchise target research, founder/operator discovery, executive identification, company enrichment, industry/location filtering, company size and job title signals, contact/persona discovery, multi-location operator discovery, and restaurant, wellness, fitness, supplement, retail, food and beverage, consumer health, investor/operator, and franchise-related target discovery.
sources.limitations: Apollo is not a source of truth. Apollo-derived findings must be labeled as enrichment signals unless corroborated by lawful public sources or owner-provided evidence. Apollo alone must not support final ownership, capital readiness, franchise-fit, authority, or Executive Intelligence conclusions.

sources.title: Prometheus Company Identity v1

sources.limitations: Internal identity source; external market claims still need external evidence.

sources.title: Prometheus Product Vision v1
sources.usage: Internal product thesis and horizontal industry direction.
sources.limitations: Internal strategy source; external market claims still need external evidence.

sources.title: Prometheus Company Manual

sources.title: Prometheus Research Foundation
sources.usage: Canonical Research entrypoint for foundation, briefing-system, source-policy, and handoff references.

sources.title: Market Intelligence Engine v1

sources.title: Customer Intelligence Graph

sources.title: Adaptive Outside Sales Intelligence Engine

sources.limitations: Architecture-only source; does not authorize production integration.

sources.title: Prometheus Competitor Research

sources.title: Competitor Pricing And Revenue Snapshot

sources.title: USPTO Patent Public Search
